entries.title: I Chronicles 10:1
segments: Mount Gilboa; on the south of the valley of Esdraelon, sometimes called the valley of Jezreel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 10:4
segments: Those who have not chosen God as their portion and have no hope in his mercy, are often very miserable when they come to die; and sometimes are ready to hasten their death by their own hands.

entries.title: I Chronicles 10:6

, survived him, and also Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan.  Ziba also, one of the servants belonging to Saul's house, is mentioned in

entries.title: I Chronicles 10:9
segments: To carry tidings unto their idols; to whose aid they ascribed their victory.

entries.title: I Chronicles 10:10
segments: Fastened his head; his body had been fastened to the wall in Beth-shan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 10:12
segments: Jabesh; on the east of Jordan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 10:14
segments: To seek help from evil spirits is a great sin, and exposes those who do it to the just judgments of God.  Pretensions to converse with departed spirits dishonor him and his word, and should be refrained from and discountenanced.
